# Base USDC Tools — Paid experiments discontinued (October 2026)

DO NOT TRANSFER USDC. Paid Base Mainnet MCP experiments 001D/001E (Hash
Encoding), 002 (Payment Assurance), and 003 (Receivables Auditor) are no
longer offered for new purchases, pilots or integrations.

Historic /buy links, MCP endpoints, OpenAPI payment metadata, cached prices,
receiving addresses and third-party directories are NOT current offers. This
notice does not stop irreversible on-chain transfers or switch off a Worker.

We have NOT independently confirmed that zero payments or outstanding credits
exist. Historical ledgers and evidence must be preserved pending a separate
obligations review. There is no automated refund facility.

To request private follow-up on previously paid credits, create a brief public
GitHub issue at https://github.com/PGhannmmn/base-usdc-mcp-tools/issues/new .
Do NOT publish wallet addresses, tx hashes, tokens, signatures or secrets.

The free, offline synthetic QA resource remains archived at
https://pghannmmn.github.io/base-usdc-mcp-tools/qa-fixture-kit/
No ongoing support or new feature development is promised.
